description: Ministry of Finance, Economic Development, Policy Formulation, Planning and Tourism - Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52) as Amended and Published as Excise Notification were Passed by Parliament
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the parliamentary approval of Excise Notifications issued under the Excise Ordinance. It deals specifically with legal/regulatory matters - the validation and passage of statutory instruments (Excise Notifications No. 01/2024, 02/2024, and 03/2024) by Parliament. The content focuses on the legal framework and regulatory process rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
